sections.title: Form and origin
sections.text: Mammillaria bombycina is a clumping cactus from Mexico, including Aguascalientes and Jalisco, in dry habitats. Its cylindrical stems can reach about 20 cm.

sections.title: Spines and flowers
sections.text: The stems bear white wool and hooked reddish-brown central spines. The deep pink flowers are about 1.5 cm across. It resembles M. bocasana but has taller, more cylindrical stems and brighter flowers.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use was verified for this species.
